blurb:
SHOOTING&SPINNING IS ALLOWED FROM 18 YEARS OF AGE. In case it is a group, everyone must be 18+

Unleash your inner artist with our exhilarating paintball spin art experience! Armed with airsoft guns, you'll skillfully shoot down balloons filled with vibrant paint. Once your canvas is splashed with an array of colors, we'll set it in motion, spinning to create a mesmerizing abstract masterpiece. This thrilling activity is designed for ages 18 and above, providing an immersive and unforgettable artistic adventure. Each team receives a 16x20 inch canvas, seven paint bombs, and protective gear for a dynamic and engaging creative session. Immerse yourself in the excitement of creating unique, paint-splattered art like never before!
